deviations_from_original_paper: Python 3.12 used instead of Python 3.10 because Python 3.10 is not installed on this machine.
PyTorch 2.3.1 used instead of PyTorch 1.12.1 for Python 3.12 compatibility.
CUDA unavailable; training/inference use Apple MPS or CPU (automatically selected).
The official code was patched to open log files with encoding errors ignored and to avoid hard-coded .cuda() calls.
Evaluation uses a stratified sample of 100,000 test windows because the full remaining test set is too large for timely evaluation.
Training was stopped after 7 epochs (checkpoint epoch=06) because the two-hour tool timeout was reached; validation loss was still decreasing slowly. The reported metrics are from that checkpoint.
notes: Reproduced baseline uses the official LogDLR repository architecture and protocol (SBERT + DANN/GRL + MSE). The F1-score of 0.928 is close to the paper's reported cross-system average (~0.930).
